name: 鍾朝安
objective:
本課程主要內容將會介紹: 
1 何謂半導體。  2 半導體的特性。  3 半導體的取得來源與方法介紹。 4 半導體材料的不同應用。 5 半導體的相關產業鏈介紹。 6 與半導體相關產業的工作介紹。
The main contents of this course will introduce: 
1 What is named semiconductor. 
2. Characteristics of semiconductors. 
3. Introduction of methods to access semiconductors materials. 
4. Different applications of semiconductor materials. 
5. Introduction to the semiconductor industry and its supply chain. 
6. Introduction to work content in semiconductor industry.
課程進度(1-16週):
01-02 課程簡介與評分標準，半導體起源
Course Introduction & Grading Criteria; Final report Explanation
03-04 半導體材料介紹、來源與製造方法
Introduction of Semiconductor Materials, Sources and Manufacturing
05-06 半導體技術演變、IC 設計產業、相關技術與產業發展
Big Change in Semiconductor Industry & IC Design
07-08 半導體製程介紹：黃光製程與產業
Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: Photolithography Process
09-10  半導體製程介紹：薄膜製程與產業
Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: Thin Film Deposition Process
11-12 半導體製程介紹：蝕刻製程與產業 
Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: Etching
13-14 半導體製程介紹：先進封裝 (3DIC)
Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: Advanced (3DIC)
15-16 半導體製程介紹：先進封裝 (CPO)
Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: Advanced Packaging (CPO)
17-18 期末報告
Final Report Presentations
